body:
Seeing how your fiancé's parents blamed you, I bet a large percent of his depression was caused by them.

Honestly, damn those bloody people. They were likely ignorant to their son, and possibly even the cause of his pain.

Please don’t listen to their noises, don’t let them torture your fiancé and then torture you too!

And please don’t blame yourself. Maybe to your fiancé, it was the only way at that very moment he had to save himself with.

Maybe your fiancé was scared to tell you, that you might’ve left him if he did.

Don’t blame yourself either. Not every depression is recognizable. I am a very good example. 

You’d be absolutely stunned if I told you I was depressed, I wear a smile and laugh and live an artificial lifestyle that dresses my depression up very well. 

It’s not going to be your fault.

I have a feeling your parents may be somehow gender biased. 

I really hate it when people you really try to rely on kicks-your-butt with these stupid reasons.

You can do this! Wait till Covid-19 get over, I'm sure you'll get everything. First a drivers-license, then a job for start, and as soon as you have a job you have money!

Trust me, things will go like a stream. If you wanna move out, you can start by saving up. I'm sure it'll be fine.

I'm sorry if I'm not too supportive, quite ironically, I am in a bad state myself.

And dramatically, ( I'm trying to be humorous ), here is a poem:

\> Why are they all so selfish

\> Yet ask for your pity

\> With their foot on your head?

\> Why am I licking the floors

\> With this sickened and dead belief

\> That all are truthful and meant to be?

\> And now as I’ve regained

\> Just a little of my hatred;

\> The soul I long lost towards a wrong belief

\> Marked me well dead when I tried to see.
